key_provisions_or_claims: Foreign visitors for business, exhibitions or training must be filed in advance (48 hours) by an inviting organisation via the zone's information platform.
Foreign persons may stay in the zone for 30 days, extendable by up to 30 more days.
Domestic entrants need passes: up to 30 days for short-term activities, up to 1 year for routine workers.
Designated vehicles must register in advance and pass immigration inspection.
Immigration authorities facilitate emergency access and enforce violations under law.
annotation.summary_en: Interim rules issued by China's National Immigration Administration governing entry and exit of people and vehicles at the Shanghai Oriental Hub International Business Cooperation Zone, covering filing for foreign visitors, stay limits, passes for domestic entrants, and vehicle registration. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
